deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary p95 for /v1/generate on redwood-3b-quant = 1.8x baseline. Suggested auto-rollback to v2.3.1 due to kernel OOM signal.
Mia: noticed same in dashboards. but the spike looks concentrated to one slice.
Alex: is this synthetic? last test run was around deploy time.
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback policy: p95 >1.5x for >5m. Current alert age: 3m.
Sam (sre): hold autos. Synthetic runner often skews metrics. Alex, run `./tools/slice-inspect --route /v1/generate --last 10m`
Alex: output: slice-2 tagged synthetic, avg_len=1200, qps=6; prod slices normal.
Priya (product): avoid customer-facing rollback if it's synthetic. Suggest pin prod to v2.3.0 and keep canary at v2.3.3 for diagnostics.
Sam (sre): ok will dry-run pin: `rwctl pin --route /v1/generate --version 2.3.0 --scope production --dry-run` -> OK. Applying in 20s unless objections.
Mia: creating incident and notifying CS.
Jordan (legal): fine with pin; notify me if EU routing changes.
Sam (sre): applied pin at 09:16:40 UTC. Prod -> v2.3.0, canary stays v2.3.3 on synthetic slice.
Alex: prod p95 back to baseline. Canary still high (synthetic).
Priya (product): drafting short customer note and release note diff.
Sam (sre): decision: manual pin to avoid noisy auto-rollback. Follow-ups: tag synthetic slices in monitors, require cross-slice confirmation before auto-rollback. Ticket: INF-4721-FU. :white_check_mark:
